cover.desc: Full color, warm and ordinary. A small apartment kitchen in late morning sun, seen from the doorway. Kou at the stove with a tea towel over one shoulder; Kanade sitting up on the counter in weekend clothes with a spoon in one hand and a battered notebook open on her knee; a six-year-old kneeling on a chair reaching for the pan; a thirteen-year-old at the low table behind them not looking up from her homework. Steam. Four bowls stacked on the side. Flat cel colour, cream and pale blue and dusty rose, hard-edged soft shadows, one big window of warm light, generous negative space. Nothing dramatic is happening.

panels.action: Five months later. Nothing dramatic is happening.

dialogue.text: Five months later.
The tower's still there. It still charges the same.
Nobody's been past the door in eleven weeks, because nobody has to be.

chars.name: shizu

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: washing up

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: genuinely surprised, which is rare

chars.expression: half a shrug, honest

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not letting that stand

She wanted to carry one herself.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: holding the mug, and it is warm, and that is a whole thing

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: doing his half of it

panels.action: And he does his half, which he has done since the corridor.

Same one. Status unchanged.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: small, private, entirely content

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: walking a night street beside her, hands in pockets

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: on his left, where she always is

Thursday.

Eleven. Same as always.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: noticing something and not saying it

panels.action: He notices she is on his left, which she has been for seven months.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: saying it sideways

chars.name: kanade

chars.expression: >_<, scarlet, tiny

chars.name: kou

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: taking the key, and answering in her own grammar

chars.name: kou

It's your book too now.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: alarmed, genuinely

dialogue.text: You've never cooked anything in your life.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: holding up the notebook

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: half a real smile

dialogue.text: Half eleven, then.
Half eleven.
Don't change the number.

chars.name: kanade

dialogue.text: Fourteen months ago I had four hundred acquaintances.

chars.name: kanade

dialogue.text: ZERO. ZERO. ZERO. ZERO.

chars.name: kanade

IT'S STILL NEW.

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: kou

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: tasting it, eyes closed, taking it entirely seriously

dialogue.text: ...Salt's under. And the sharp thing's arrived first.
That's a fault. Is it a fault?
It's a fault.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: fixing it, entirely focused

panels.action: She fixes it. He tells her when to stop.

dialogue.text: Half again. Stir it and count to twenty.
You've never cooked a thing in your life.
No. But I can taste it, and you can cook it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stopping, hearing her own sentence come back at her

panels.action: That is her sentence from seven months ago, word for word.

dialogue.text: That's mine.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: writing in the notebook while stirring, one-handed

panels.action: She writes it in the book one-handed.

dialogue.text: Rice, Saturday — salt half again. Sharp thing SECOND. (H.)

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: arriving through the front door without knocking, arms full of crisps

chars.name: mio

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: coming in behind him with a folder and a bottle of something

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: kou
